finding: The twelve tools now have routes. add_zone, add_component_annotation, group_components, export_position_file, and export_vrml performed verified work. export_netlist is implemented and refused to guess a schematic for the disposable board. add_wire, add_net_class, assign_net_to_class, check_clearance, replace_component, and set_layer_constraints return UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.

When a command is handled by command_routes and is in _BOARD_MUTATING_COMMANDS, _auto_save_board calls pcbnew.SaveBoard on self.board. That writes the PCB file from the SWIG board object and can overwrite unsaved editor changes.

If use_ipc is true but ipc_board_api is missing, handle_command logs a SWIG fallback and runs command_routes. place_component's SWIG handler can LoadBoard from boardPath. clone_component has no SWIG route, so it returns Unknown command instead.

_ipc_delete_trace always calls RoutingCommands.delete_trace and returns that result. _ipc_add_board_outline sends rectangle and rounded_rectangle to the SWIG outline handler. Neither IPC return path calls _auto_save, and neither updates the open editor through IPC.

_ipc_add_net used to return success true without creating a net. KiCad 10 IPC Board has get_nets and no create_net. The handler now returns UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION for a new name and ALREADY_EXISTS for a name already on the board. The live net list stayed at 50.

rotate_component is documented as an absolute angle. The IPC handler used to add the angle to the current rotation. It now sets the absolute angle, reads the footprint back, and returns failure if the orientation or identity does not match. Live check on R_PHASE4: 90, 180, and 0 degrees, with undo back to 180 and redo to 0.

MCP resources call get_board_3d_view, get_component_3d_model, get_component_connections, get_component_details, get_component_footprint, get_component_groups, get_component_library, get_component_placement, get_component_symbol, get_component_visualization, get_library_list, get_project_files, get_project_properties, and get_project_status. Those command names are not routed.

The four similar names were compared and not aliased. add_zone and export_netlist have their own handlers. add_wire and add_net_class return UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION because their schemas and side effects do not match add_schematic_wire and create_netclass.
src/tools/registry.ts does not list every registered tool, and registerRouterTools is disabled. The category registry is not the live registration path.

move_component and delete_component still return their operation flag without a second read. rotate_component and route_trace now read the edited item back and withhold success when it does not match. clone_component and place_component already re-read the created footprint.

KiCad 10 IPC facts already established and preserved: Box2 uses pos and size; footprint identity is str(definition.id); UUID is id.value; layers 3 and 34 are F.Cu and B.Cu; FlipItems is not implemented by this KiCad build; library footprints that are not already on the board cannot be imported.

clone_component and place_component passed the prior disposable-board tests, including net clearing, duplicate rejection, exact footprint identity, inch conversion, and boardPath refusal. Phase 4 used clone only to create the disposable R_PHASE4 rotation target and then deleted it.

route_trace could return success while the created track net was empty. add_track now requires an existing net when a name is requested, reads the track back after the IPC commit, and removes it when the net does not match. A missing net creates no track. Live track aa6cbda3-6973-48bf-874f-ce402892dd7f was on +5V_ISO and was then removed.
get_tracks, get_vias, get_zones, and get_selection returned str(item.id), the protobuf text form. They now return id.value. Live track and via ids were bare UUID strings.
